---
title: "Rapport"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(knitr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

```{r}
METADATA <- fread("output/metadonnees.csv")
```

```{r, results='asis'}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(METADATA))) {
  ligne <- METADATA[i]
  cat("##", ligne$description, "\n\n")

  if (ligne$type == "Table") {
    cat(kable(fread(ligne$fichier), format = "markdown"), sep = "\n")
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("![%s](%s)\n", ligne$description, ligne$fichier))
  }

  cat("\n\n")
}
```
